about.title: The Human Element
about.description: I am a full-stack developer based in the vibrant tech hub of Medellín, Colombia. This location serves as a strategic asset for US clients, offering overlapping time zones and cost-effective, premium engineering talent. I believe that great software isn't just about writing clean code—it is about solving real business problems with intuitive, human-centric design.
